hypothesis: Replacing a_v186's heterogeneous raw job-value tuples and fixed urgency bonuses with a common terminal-net-value score that charges money, service, movement, tile, shed, cargo, and market-order opportunity costs will allocate workers and investments toward higher win-relevant marginal value and reduce profitable-looking but capacity-destroying work.

exact_code_lever.change: Create score_job(job,state,shadow) and replace the first element of tuples returned by animal_service_jobs, crop_service_jobs, development jobs, and assignment cost construction.
exact_code_lever.formula: Hard-gate exact feasibility, then net_j=E[terminal bank gain]+avoided_loss- cash_outlay-lambda_labor*service_actions-lambda_move*travel_actions-lambda_tile*tile_turns-lambda_shed*peak_slots-lambda_cargo*carried_item_turns-lambda_order*orders-price_impact-overflow_and_expiry_risk. priority_j=net_j/max(1,service_actions+travel_actions)+urgency(slack).
exact_code_lever.estimation: Estimate each lambda by bounded one-unit finite difference V(resource+1)-V(resource) from the rolling relaxation or the best rejected feasible alternative; smooth by phase and clamp nonnegative. Integer resources use finite differences, not unqualified LP duals.

affected_phase: All project, service, routing, inventory, and market choices. Resource prices vary by state: money early, labor/movement during service congestion, shed/cargo before drops, orders during purchase/liquidation bursts, tile during profitable growth, and terminal bankability late. Survival and hard deadlines remain feasibility/avoided-loss rules, not merely soft scores.
engine_mechanism: The engine couples jobs through one action per unit, movement, per-unit inventory, four shed-access cells, shed capacity 100, ten market orders, shared price impact, lifecycle caps/decay, daily survival, Fibonacci labor cost, and terminal bank reward. Raw gross yield ignores many of these displaced-resource costs. A normalized resource-price score makes unlike jobs comparable while exact preconditions prevent silent no-ops.
regime_trigger_and_forecast_error: Re-estimate shadow prices at day start and when any utilization changes >10 points, shed crosses 70/90, market order count crosses 8, minimum slack crosses 6, price moves >25%, or terminal chain becomes binding. Log predicted net value and each resource use against realized sale, actions, travel, overflow, expiry, and price. Increase risk penalty after repeated >20% overprediction [uncertain].
decision_score_audit: For every candidate record features in native and normalized units, feasibility, gross terminal gain, avoided loss, each lambda and resource quantity, risk/price impact, net, value/action, urgency, final priority, rank, selected worker, best rejected score, gap, and rejection reason. Log score version and deterministic tie-break key. The sum of components must reproduce net exactly.
admissible_workload_and_minimum_slack: Scoring follows a hard deadline-feasibility gate: demand bounds including travel/return must fit p90 capacity, mandatory utilization <=0.80, minimum slack >=4, shed/order/cash/terminal constraints satisfied. A large score cannot admit an infeasible crop, animal, land, or cargo chain. Threshold values need confirmation [uncertain].
constraint_utilization_profile: Compute lambdas alongside utilization of worker turns, movement, cash, tiles, shed, cargo, and order slots. Expected monotonicity: a resource price approaches zero when slack and rises near capacity. Report utilization-price curves and violations; reject a price model that falls materially as its resource becomes more constrained without a documented state effect.
job_queue_health: Queue telemetry by type/value includes gross/net value, value/action, age, deadline, slack, lateness, starvation, abandonment, and displaced job. Analyze whether low-net jobs age, whether urgent positive-net jobs complete, and whether survival avoided-loss jobs dominate appropriately without starving terminally valuable harvest.
spatial_logistics_metrics: Travel actions are explicit in score rather than an indirect MOVE_FRAC heuristic. Estimate assignment-specific distance, route switch, pickup/drop detour, batch compatibility, and return. Report distance/completed job, empty travel, jobs/excursion, batch size, and shed trips by score decile.
expected_terminal_value: E[terminal bank gain] values only saleable, bankable output and simulates own price impact plus absorption/opponent scenarios. Assets beyond the short horizon receive a conservative continuation value. Candidate cash/win uplift remains [uncertain].
marginal_value_per_worker_turn: Primary scheduling quantity is net_j divided by incremental service+travel actions, with hard deadline urgency separate. Report forecast and realized distributions and calibration by decile. Numerical gains are [uncertain].

shadow_price_vector.money: Finite difference in best feasible terminal value when cash capacity increases by one coin; includes financing delay.
shadow_price_vector.labor: Best rejected feasible net value per extra valid worker action or finite difference with one extra action.
shadow_price_vector.movement: Terminal loss from one forced movement/displacement, assignment-specific and bounded by labor price.
shadow_price_vector.tile: Best rejected terminal net value per occupied tile-turn.
shadow_price_vector.shed: Expected overflow/displacement value of one peak shed slot.
shadow_price_vector.cargo: Extra return, coordination, and overflow risk per carried item-turn.
shadow_price_vector.order: Best displaced purchase/sale/hire value per one of ten market-order positions.
shadow_price_vector.status: Values require implementation and training-only calibration [uncertain].

gross_to_net_value_decomposition: Store gross sale/avoided loss; input and financing cost; service; movement; tile; shed; cargo; market order; own price impact; opponent/town uncertainty; expiry/escape; overflow; and terminal infeasibility. Compare predicted components with realized ledger and attribute residual to forecast/model error.
market_and_opponent_dependence: Sale gain uses current official price curve, own planned orders, forecast town absorption, and bounded visible opponent supply. A glut raises price-impact/risk and can make harvest/production negative net even at positive gross value. Opponent identity is not a feature; observable board and market state are.
action_validity_and_noop_breakdown: Feasibility rejects wrong/locked tile, stale target, already-serviced action, missing seed/item, insufficient cash, full shed, occupied structure, duplicate contention, crop at cap/doomed, off-board move, and order truncation. Record attempted/valid/executed/no-op and predicted-versus-engine discrepancy. Candidate results are [uncertain].
micro_scenario_coverage: Tests isolate each resource price: scarce cash; one free worker action; remote versus adjacent equal harvest; last tile; shed 99/100; one cargo return; ninth/tenth/eleventh order; price floor; opponent glut; threatened asset; expiring crop; at-cap ongoing crop; fertilize net loss; two workers contending; and terminally unsellable harvest. Verify score units and monotonic finite differences.
terminal_feasibility: Terminal value is zero for cargo/output without feasible harvest/collect, route, deposit, and sell before step 719. Latest-start slack is a hard gate; lambda_order reserves a sale position. As the horizon closes, labor/movement/order shadow prices for bankability rise and tile/long-project continuation values go to zero.
paired_test_design: Compare a_v186 against a candidate changing only scores and assignment costs; preserve portfolio targets initially to isolate scheduling value. Use 1,536 paired seat outcomes across six strata. Primary paired win uplift; secondary terminal cash, realized net/action, calibration error, no-op rate, travel, overflow, and score regret.
paired_discordance_and_effect_interval: Report candidate-only/control-only wins, paired uplift and 95% cluster interval; planned MDE 3.2-5.0 points across discordance .20-.50. Effects are [uncertain].
random_stream_alignment: Changed jobs alter occupancy and hence official conditional weed draw consumption. Use event-keyed exogenous draws or audit event-key alignment and infer by opponent-seed clusters. Deterministic score ties are resolved by deadline, target coordinate, opcode, then worker index.
optional_stopping_and_multiple_testing_b: Tune at most four price-estimation variants: best-rejected versus finite-difference crossed with per-day versus event-triggered smoothing. Freeze one candidate; Holm-correct any shared validation family. Confirmation sample and promotion threshold are fixed; no repeated ordinary-interval peeking.
tuning_validation_separation: Calibrate lambdas, risk, forecast, and clamps on training opponents/seeds only. Freeze coefficients and feature definitions before validation. Confirmation uses unseen opponent hashes and fresh seeds. Score telemetry may be inspected after confirmation only for explanation, not retuning the same claim.
distributional_guardrails: Require no increase in invalid/no-op, survival misses, overflow, terminal unsold value, or catastrophic-loss rate; 10th-percentile cash not down >2,000; score calibration error decreasing by decile; and no seat/stratum win loss >3 points. Results are [uncertain].
robustness_regret: Compute realized regret against the hindsight best feasible job per decision window, best score variant per stratum, and a_v186. Separate ranking regret, forecast regret, and feasibility-model regret. No results [uncertain].
rare_event_stress_results: Stress extreme scarcity of each resource, simultaneous deadlines, price floor/rebound, duplicated shops, dense weeds, wheat/cash shock, full shed, remote cargo, order saturation, and terminal reversal. Verify prices rise with scarcity and safety gates dominate. Results are [uncertain].
interaction_and_ablation_matrix: Ablate each lambda, normalization, urgency, own price impact, uncertainty penalty, and terminal gate. Test interactions with workload admission, rolling horizon, endogenous regimes, and hiring reservation; leave-one-out establishes whether a complex price is actually useful. Results are [uncertain].
promotion_margin_and_reversion_trigger: Promote with >=+5-point paired win uplift, lower bound >0, positive realized net/action, stable calibration, and all subgroup/safety guardrails. Revert if scoring admits infeasible work, a lambda becomes nonfinite/negative outside a declared credit case, modeled-versus-engine mismatch >0.1%, no-op rises >0.5 points, or live win rate drops >5 points/100 games.
confidence_and_status: High confidence in opportunity-cost decomposition; medium confidence that finite differences can be estimated robustly within the action budget for this integer, nonstationary game. Implementation/benchmark pending; do not promote [uncertain].
computational_budget: Cache resource-price estimates and update only on triggers. Score at most HUNGARIAN_JOBS=48 per planner call, target <20 ms and <10 MB. Finite differences use a bounded relaxation, not full episode rollouts. On nonfinite price, model error, or cutoff, use last valid clamped vector; if absent, use a_v186 raw values while retaining hard feasibility gates.
